## E-two — Competitive teardown

No competitor product was reviewed for this section, so this teardown carries no named rival, no pricing, no structure comparison, and no praise-or-complaint record.

The adopt-and-beat analysis from the master template is explicitly out of scope for this handbook-section dossier; a future market pass with its own sources would own it.

Pedagogy, practice-item, and coverage comparison tables are therefore absent here by explicit scope choice, not by omission.

Disposition: teardown for this section is present as an explicit scoped statement, not as researched competitive evidence.
